added.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/13/2026

Location: Milpitas, CA or Boston, MA Preferred Hybrid

Alternate Locations: Open to remote anywhere in the US for candidates outside of these locations

Meet the Team

You will join the Policy and Data Platform team, the group responsible for building the security policy systems that protect customers' environments. The team builds the platform that lets customers define, enforce, and manage security policies at scale across their infrastructure. This work spans UI, data engineering, platform architecture, and policy enforcement, with a strong emphasis on reliability and trust. The team works across Cisco to enable other teams to integrate with the platform, strengthening the signals used to recommend new policies and expanding the number of enforcement points.

Your Impact

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Policy and Data Platform.
Build and scale a multi-team engineering organization, developing managers and senior engineers.
Translate customer security policy needs into durable technical systems.
Partner with product and security teams to align platform capabilities with customer needs.
Set engineering standards and operational practices that improve platform reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, with 15+ years of software engineering experience.
5+ years of experience in an engineering leadership role managing managers or senior engineers.
Experience architecting and scaling data platforms or policy systems in production.
Experience managing engineering budgets and resource planning for an organization of 30+ engineers.
Experience delivering large-scale distributed systems from design through production launch.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building systems that secure customer environments, such as access control, firewall, or workload protection policies.
Familiarity with security policy enforcement across cloud, network, or hybrid environments.
Strong communicator able to translate technical tradeoffs into business terms for executives.
Experience building and scaling engineering teams through periods of rapid growth.
Demonstrated ability to build trust and alignment across cross-functional, matrixed organizations.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Work intimately with the corporate risk management team to ensure all insurance requirements are met and maximize company underwriting and insurance pricing advantage.
Ensure proactive approach to controlling risk cost as compared to competitors.
Create a phased three year plan to advance the sustainability guidelines and practices related to HHM’s Earth View program as well as maximizing hotel asset energy efficiency.
Develop and maintain hotel brand relationships and negotiate project requirements in an effort to meet brand standards and owner’s expectations related to budget and expectations.

Negotiate with contractors andvendors to achieve best value for labor and materials associated with the property improvement/development plan and in accordance with franchise requirements.
Review, analyze, and interpret construction drawings and specifications as necessary.
As needed, assist field personnel with coordination relative to state, county and townshiprequirements for permits/inspections and to attend related meetings.

Educate and train property level Engineers on current safety issues to ensure compliance with all federal, state and local laws and safety regulations.

Promote and enforce organized paperwork management by property engineering staff. Ensure all PM logs are kept current.

Practice safe work habits, wear protective safety equipment and follow MSDS and OSHA standards.
Perform other duties as requested by management.

Position Requirements

10+years of progressive experience in multi-property facility management, development and construction in the hospitality industry.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a similar practice preferred and/or significant relevant experience.
Superior analytical skills and extensive experience with analysis/utilization of reports, P&L's and balance sheets to develop budgets and supportable projections.
Extensive project management experience.
Any of the following certifications are highly desirable: Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) and/or Certified Construction Manager (CCM) certified by the Construction Manager Certification Institute (CMCI).

added.title: Head of Engineering
added.description:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Team

We are hiring a Head of Engineering to own the craft, quality, and technical direction of a roughly 30-person engineering organization. This is deliberately not a role about growing headcount to 150. It is a role about making a small, senior team produce output that looks like a much larger one — by raising the engineering bar, tightening the systems that move real money, and being genuinely in the code and the architecture rather than adjacent to it.

You will lead through a mix of direct reports and a small group of engineering managers and tech leads, partnering closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance. You will spend your time on design reviews, incident retros, hiring, and the handful of technical bets that determine whether we can support the next order of magnitude of transaction volume.

If your ideal week is entirely calendar blocks and roadmap decks, this is not the right role. If your ideal week includes a hard design debate, a code review that changes someone's mind, and a coaching conversation that raises a manager's ceiling, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Set and own Rain’s engineering quality bar across system design, code review, testing, observability, documentation, and technical decision-making, ensuring correctness is treated as critical for systems that move customer funds.
Provide hands-on technical leadership by staying active in the codebase, reviewing critical PRs and designs, prototyping high-risk components, debugging production issues, and making key architectural and build-vs.-buy decisions.
Own the technical architecture and strategy across card issuing, wallets, ledger, money movement, onchain settlement, and integrations with card networks and banking partners.
Drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence by establishing SLOs, improving incident response, capacity planning for 10x growth, and designing resilient systems with graceful degradation, idempotency, and replay capabilities.
Build security, compliance, and correctness into the platform by design, partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, and Security to meet PCI, SOC 2, fraud-control, regulatory, and blockchain infrastructure requirements.
Increase engineering velocity without sacrificing quality through improvements to CI/CD, developer tooling, local environments, technical debt management, and architecture that enables teams to ship safely and independently.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by coaching engineering managers and technical leads, maintaining a high hiring and performance bar, establishing clear team ownership, and partnering effectively across Product, Design, Risk, Compliance, and GTM.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

10+ years building production software, including 4+ years leading engineers — ideally as a Head of Engineering, Director, or Senior EM at a company where the systems handled real consequences.
Currently and demonstrably hands-on. You have written or reviewed meaningful production code within the last year and you want a role where that continues.
Deep experience with distributed backend systems at scale: data modeling, consistency and idempotency, queues and event-driven design, and the operational reality of running all of it.
A track record of raising an engineering bar. You can point to specific practices you introduced and the measurable change in quality, velocity, or reliability that followed.
Real reliability ownership — you have carried a pager, run incident command during a serious outage, and built the follow-through that kept it from recurring.
Experience in payments, fintech, banking infrastructure, or another domain where money, ledgers, or regulatory obligations made correctness non-negotiable.
Strong hiring and coaching instincts, with managers or senior engineers you have developed who would work for you again.
Clear written communication. You can make a complex technical tradeoff legible to a CEO, a compliance officer, and a partner's engineering team in the same week.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You would rather ship something correct this quarter than design something perfect for next year.

Bonus attributes:

Hands-on experience with card issuing, processing, or the Visa and Mastercard network stack.
Working knowledge of stablecoins, onchain settlement, custody and key management, or EVM and Solana infrastructure.
Experience operating under SOC 2, PCI DSS, or bank and program-manager oversight.
Experience leading distributed or multi-region teams.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan
📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $280K - $380K

added.description:
About Us

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

The Sr. Director of Engineering Operations & Security will lead the organization responsible for how Vida builds, ships, secures, and operates from the test suite and the deploy pipeline, through our cloud infrastructure and corporate IT estate, out to the client data integrations and escalation paths where our enterprise customers feel every failure directly. When a member's eligibility file doesn't land, your team owns it. When a release regresses, your team's quality gates should have caught it. When a health plan sends a security questionnaire, you're the person who answers it. You will also serve as Vida's Security Officer, accountable for our information security program in a business where the trust of payers, employers, and members is inseparable from the product itself.

Responsibilities

Own test strategy and automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud platform, and developer environments.
Set and enforce the quality gates and deployment practices that let product engineering move quickly without breaking things.
Drive measurable improvement in developer productivity, build and deploy reliability, and time to recovery.
Own corporate IT, identity and access management, endpoint and device management, and SaaS and vendor security.
Serve as Vida's Security Officer with named accountability for the information security program: policy ownership, risk assessment, security awareness, vulnerability management, and incident response.
Act as the executive point of contact for customer security diligence, questionnaires, and audit activity, and make that process a fast, unremarkable part of the sales cycle.
Build and lead the security roadmap, and hire the security depth the program requires.
Own client data operations and eligibility and data feed operations end to end, including their reliability, monitoring, and automation.
Own Tier 2/3 technical escalations from Customer Success, with clear SLAs and a durable prioritization partnership with CS leadership.
Transition this team from a support-shaped function into an engineering-shaped one: better tooling, engineering standards, meaningful automation, and a real career ladder for the people on it.
Own incident management for customer-visible issues, including on-call rotations, escalation paths, incident command, and the postmortem discipline that keeps the same incident from recurring.
Establish one operating standard across all of your teams including shared on-call practices, a single incident process, common definitions of healthy, and metrics that leadership actually reviews.
Define and report the small set of reliability and security measures that give the company a shared language for system health.
Develop the Managers and Senior Engineers you inherit, assess the bench honestly, and hire to fill the gaps.
Land the Production Operations transition into Engineering without dropping a customer commitment.
Stand up the SLA and prioritization agreement with Customer Success, and reduce the team's manual workload enough that its capacity isn't capped by toil.
Take clear ownership of the security program, publish a prioritized roadmap with real dates, and get current on our posture and gaps.
Unify on-call and incident practice across the organization.
Additional resposibilities as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree at a minimum.
10+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading multiple teams and developing Engineering Managers.
Direct ownership of DevOps, SRE, platform, or engineering operations at meaningful scale, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
Experience owning a customer-facing production operations, integrations, or technical support function with real SLAs and real consequences when they slip.
Demonstrated track record running incident management and on-call for production systems, including leading incidents and driving fixes that hold.
Experience operating inside a regulated environment: HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, PCI, or comparable, with enough fluency to take ownership of a security program with appropriate support around you.
Proven ability to absorb and restructure a team inherited from another part of the business, including the change management required to make it stick.
Comfort with genuine breadth across quality engineering, infrastructure, corporate IT, security, and customer-facing operations

Preferred

Prior experience as a designated Security Officer, Information Security Officer, or equivalent.
Technical ownership of a SOC 2 Type II or HITRUST certification effort.
Healthcare data integration experience with eligibility files, 834/837, HL7, FHIR, claims, or comparable enterprise data exchange.
Quality engineering leadership with experience building a test automation strategy rather than inheriting one.
Corporate IT ownership at a company scaling past several hundred employees.
Experience in virtual care, digital health, or another environment where clinical and enterprise requirements both apply.

$240,000 - $250,000 a year

Vida is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer.

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Team

We are hiring a Head of Engineering to own the craft, quality, and technical direction of a roughly 50-person engineering organization. This is deliberately not a role about growing headcount to 150. It is a role about making a small, senior team produce output that looks like a much larger one — by raising the engineering bar, tightening the systems that move real money, and being genuinely in the code and the architecture rather than adjacent to it.

You will lead through a mix of direct reports and a small group of engineering managers and tech leads, partnering closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance. You will spend your time on design reviews, incident retros, hiring, and the handful of technical bets that determine whether we can support the next order of magnitude of transaction volume.

If your ideal week is entirely calendar blocks and roadmap decks, this is not the right role. If your ideal week includes a hard design debate, a code review that changes someone's mind, and a coaching conversation that raises a manager's ceiling, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Own engineering strategy and architecture across card issuing, wallets, ledger, money movement, onchain settlement, and integrations with card networks and banking partners — including the multi-year technical roadmap that gets us there.
Set and own Rain's engineering quality bar across system design, code review, testing, observability, documentation, and technical decision-making, ensuring correctness is treated as critical for systems that move customer funds.
Go deep where the risk is. You won't own day-to-day code, but you will review critical designs, weigh in on the highest-consequence architecture and build-vs.-buy decisions, and be technical enough that no one can hand you a bad design and have it pass.
Drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence by establishing SLOs, improving incident response, capacity planning for 10x growth, and designing resilient systems with graceful degradation, idempotency, and replay capabilities.
Build security, compliance, and correctness into the platform by design, partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, and Security to meet PCI, SOC 2, fraud-control, regulatory, and blockchain infrastructure requirements.
Increase engineering velocity without sacrificing quality through improvements to CI/CD, developer tooling, local environments, technical debt management, and architecture that enables teams to ship safely and independently.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by hiring and coaching engineering managers and technical leads, establishing clear team ownership and boundaries, and owning headcount planning and the performance bar.
Operate as a member of the leadership team — translating company strategy into technical plans, partnering across Product, Design, Risk, Compliance, and GTM, and representing engineering to the board, banking and network partners, and customers.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

15+ years building production software, including 8+ years leading engineers and meaningful time leading managers.
Current technical credibility. You have written or reviewed meaningful production code recently enough that an architecture review is a place you add value, not a place you nod along.
Deep experience with distributed backend systems at scale: data modeling, consistency and idempotency, queues and event-driven design, and the operational reality of running all of it.
A track record of raising an engineering bar. You can point to specific practices you introduced and the measurable change in quality, velocity, or reliability that followed.
Real reliability ownership — you have carried a pager, run incident command during a serious outage, and built the follow-through that kept it from recurring.
Experience in payments, fintech, banking infrastructure, or another domain where money, ledgers, or regulatory obligations made correctness non-negotiable.
You have hired and developed engineering managers, not only engineers. There are leaders you grew who would come work for you again.
Clear written communication. You can make a complex technical tradeoff legible to a CEO, a compliance officer, and a partner's engineering team in the same week.
Executive range. You are as comfortable in a board or partner conversation as you are in a design review, and you can hold a technical position under commercial pressure.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You would rather ship something correct this quarter than design something perfect for next year.

Bonus attributes:

Hands-on experience with card issuing, processing, or the Visa and Mastercard network stack.
Working knowledge of stablecoins, onchain settlement, custody and key management, or EVM and Solana infrastructure.
Experience operating under SOC 2, PCI DSS, or bank and program-manager oversight.
Experience leading distributed or multi-region teams.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Health and Wellness
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Job Description

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE‑ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trusted automated‑driving products. As the central authority for automated driving system (ADS) safety, SAFE‑ADS brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated‑driving technologies.

GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion—and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision.

As Sr Manager, AV Behavior Safety Engineering, you will lead the strategy and support execution for how GM defines, measures, and validates the safety of SAE Level 3 – 4 Automated Driving Systems powered by machine‑learned models. You will report into the AV Safety Strategy and Assurance organization and directly influence launch decisions for GM’s next generation of automated driving products.

If you are passionate about safety, have deep experience in autonomous vehicle development and validation, and are a proven technical leader in AI/ML‑driven systems, this role is an opportunity to shape how millions of people experience safe automated driving.

The Role

The AV Safety Strategy and Assurance team is seeking a hands‑on technical senior manager with extensive experience in the end‑to‑end development lifecycle of autonomous vehicle behaviors, from ODD and behavior definition through simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road validation.

You will:

Lead Technically

Reference and interpret standards such as ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 5083, and AVSC best practices to define GM’s strategy for safe autonomous system development, validation and deployment
Own the behavior‑focused portion of the ADS Safety Case, including key claims, sufficiency criteria, and recommended evidence for AV behavior safety performance.
Collaborate with Software Validation, Embodied AI, Simulation, and Safety Metrics teams to define the end‑to‑end AV behavior validation methodology for AI‑driven systems.
Set the strategy for how we systematically break down ODDs and how performance is validated per behavior and in aggregate.
Collaborate on evaluation metrics, human benchmarks, and safety launch targets for AV behaviors and overall system performance. This includes supporting development of safety performance indicators (SPIs) for AV behaviors.
Assess AV performance across safety and reliability dimensions using simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road data and provide clear, prioritized feedback to engineering teams
Define and run an assurance process to verify the sufficiency criteria and safety targets to support launch readiness

Lead People

Hire, lead, and develop a high‑performing AV behavior safety engineering team.
Set clear goals and expectations, provide coaching and mentorship, and grow the team’s technical depth in AV behavior safety, validation, and safety case development.

Why This Role Is Unique

Impact at Scale: Your work will directly influence how GM brings safe automated driving systems to millions of customers.
End‑to‑End Ownership: You will own the strategy, framework, and evidence assessment for AV behavior safety.
Cross‑Functional Reach: You will collaborate across AI, software, validation, simulation, metrics operations and vehicle program teams, shaping the direction of GM’s automated driving roadmap.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
8+ years of experience in machine learning, engineering, data science, or a related field
8+ years in autonomous vehicle or robotics development or related field
Demonstrated experience working on production‑intent AV programs
Track record providing technical safety leadership in AV development (e.g., defining safety strategies, risk assessments, validation methodologies, safety case contributions).
Deep understanding of AV behavior development: defining ODDs, behaviors, and evaluation criteria; analyzing simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road test data; and generating prioritized, actionable recommendations for developers.
Experience applying AV safety standards and best practices, such as ISO 5083, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and AVSC practices
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs to executives and non‑technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross‑functional teams (Software, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, Product, Program Management, Operations) without direct authority.
Strong problem‑solving mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a proactive attitude toward learning and continuous improvement.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including hiring, leading, and growing high‑performing technical teams.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
Programming & Frameworks: Python, R, Java, PySpark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, SQL
Machine Learning & AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, Deep learning, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), SVM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Decision Trees, Clustering
Cloud & Big Data Platforms: (Preferred Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Machine Learning, Databricks)), Nice to Have (AWS (S3, SageMaker, Bedrock) or Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, AI Platform) )
Deployment & MLOps: MLflow, Model Monitoring & Versioning, Docker & Kubernetes, GitHub, Jira

Job Description

OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) AI Infrastructure is at the forefront of building a cutting-edge, ultra-high-performance GPU platform designed to support AI/ML/HPC workloads. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution, creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance.

Our team is responsible for designing and developing fundamental architectural changes for GPU delivery, health monitoring, triage automation, and diagnostic services. These are essential for running distributed AI/ML/HPC workloads across thousands of GPUs, leveraging technologies like RoCE and InfiniBand.

We're looking for an experienced front-line engineering manager to lead and support AI Data Plane (DP) team. You'll build a highly available, massive scale, integrated cloud service in a distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment for hyper-scale AI customers.

You'll bring experience in leading engineering teams, including hands-on technical management and on-call experience. You have technical experience with high-performance, mission-critical environments. You demonstrate strong ownership, solid communication skills and a bias for action. You're comfortable leading projects, communicating with senior leadership, and growing your team.

Why Join Us?

Innovative Projects: Build groundbreaking solutions for our customers from the ground up.
Exciting Times: Be part of a young, fast-growing team working on ambitious new initiatives.
Dynamic Environment: Collaborate in a vibrant, agile environment where learning and adaptability are key.

What We’re Looking For:

Adaptable Engineers: Self-motivated individuals with a quick learning ability.

Technical Excellence: Rock-solid developers and distributed systems engineers with a deep understanding of distributed systems and algorithms. Comfortable diving deep into any part of the stack, as well as software debugging and low-level systems troubleshooting.

Passion for Simplicity and Scale: Value simplicity and scalability in design and implementation.

Collaborative Spirit: Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile environment and eager to learn. Ability to collaborate effectively with various dependencies, including Network and Data Center operations.

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start-up, with the scale and customer-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world.

Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future.

You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you’ll belong and be encouraged.

Responsibilities

Plan and drive engineering projects to successfully deliver that value to our customers, while managing risks and blockers along the way. People management. You'll handle coaching and performance-management for the engineers on your team. You'll forecast staffing needs, and then work with our recruiting teams to hire those positions.
Process improvement. You'll work across engineering teams to identify and resolve systemic problems and bottlenecks, to improve our overall engineering velocity and efficiency.
This role is inherently cross-functional and requires the ability to collaborate with PM team and other teams across OCI Core Service teams (Compute, Storage, Network)

Job Description

Reporting to the Research and Development Sciences (RaDS) Value Team lead within Research and Development (R&D) IT, the Discovery, Preclinical Translational Medicine (DPTM) Business Technology Partner will lead the team accountable for partnering with DPTM to shape business strategy, define the future-state digital ecosystem, and deliver the capabilities needed to advance discovery science. The role be the primary point of contact for senior DPTM leaders, translate scientific priorities into product and investment strategy, and drive transformation through data, analytics, AI/ML, and modern research platforms. Success will require connecting end-to-end business strategy to technical solutions, reducing functional silos, simplifying the system footprint, and securing investment in the highest-value transformational opportunities. The incumbent will also have overall IT accountability for the Discovery AI ‘Lighthouse’ initiative, one of five enterprise investments focused on accelerating value realization through AI and lab-in-the-loop automation.

The successful candidate will help define the next evolution of Digital Solutions, moving beyond traditional technology partnership toward accountable product leadership for research capabilities that accelerate scientific understanding, scientific design, and data-driven decision-making. The role may assume ownership of product capabilities and teams aligned to Discovery and Translational Science outcomes, working with Scientific Data & Analytics and Lab Operations & Platforms to deliver integrated capabilities across evidence generation, information generation, and insight generation. This leader will shape strategy, define product vision, establish outcome-based roadmaps, and build product organizations that can respond with speed and agility to evolving scientific and technology opportunities.

Primary Responsibilities

Own and continuously strengthen the strategic relationship with the DPTM leadership team, serving as the primary digital partner for translating scientific priorities into product strategy, capability investments, and measurable delivery outcomes.
Lead Discovery and Translational Science product strategy, including product vision, capability roadmaps, investment priorities, and tradeoff decisions that maximize scientific and business value.
Build and evolve high-performing product teams that accelerate scientific understanding, candidate design, and decision-making through innovative use of data, analytics, AI, and experimental evidence.
Inspire and lead through influence across scientific, business, and technology organizations.
Resolve competing stakeholder priorities by creating shared understanding of scientific value, delivery tradeoffs, and decision criteria.
Develop talent and organizational capabilities that strengthen product management, scientific informatics, and digital innovation.
Create an environment that encourages experimentation, rapid learning, and responsible adoption of emerging technologies.
Build strong cross functional relationships with various business stakeholders and IT teams, applying expertise to resolve complex scientific technology and data problems.
As Digital Solutions evolves, the role may take on direct ownership for selected Discovery and Translational Science product capabilities
Partner with RaDS product leaders and scientific leadership to define product strategy, prioritize capability investments, establish outcome-based roadmaps, and negotiate tradeoffs that maximize scientific and business value realization.

Education Minimum

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or Life Science

10+ years prior experience in leadership roles in life sciences or technology, including management and development of teams and people managers.
Broad understanding of drug discovery and early development processes, technologies and data types
Demonstrated ability to articulate strategy, translate to technology roadmaps, and influence enterprise technology strategy.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with and through others to achieve shared goals
Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic approach to addressing challenges and negotiating collaborative approaches to shared outcomes
Outstanding executive communication skills, with the ability to listen with empathy, simplify complex scientific and technology concepts, and influence stakeholders toward the highest-value opportunities.
Self-directed, motivated leader who can operate with limited direction, identify what is needed, and drive results through ambiguity.
Demonstrated experience translating enterprise strategy into measurable business and scientific outcomes.
Experience operating across executive stakeholder groups and influencing prioritization, investment, and organizational change.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through ambiguity and transformation.
Experience balancing short-term value delivery with long-term product and platform strategy.

Experience with AI/ML, genomics, research information systems, lab automation
Business process design & Change management
Product leadership experience in scientific, research, data, or technology domains.
Demonstrated experience moving innovation programs from concept through adoption, scaling, and value realization.
